client_id.title: CarData Client ID
client_id.description: Enter the Client ID of your BMW or MINI CarData client. You create it once on the My BMW or My MINI website, so the app can read your car's data.
client_id.label: Client ID
client_id.help: The Client ID is a UUID in the format xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx. After this step the app shows a code to approve with your My BMW or My MINI account.

how_to_get.title: How to get a Client ID
how_to_get.step1: Sign in on the My BMW or My MINI website for your country and open your vehicle overview
how_to_get.step2: Select your car, open the BMW CarData tile (on MINI: MINI CarData) and press Create CarData Client
how_to_get.step3: Switch on both CarData API and CarData Stream, then copy the Client ID. If the portal shows a scope error, reload the page, add one, wait about 30 seconds, then add the other
how_to_get.step4: Under CarData Stream, open Change data selection, tick the data items the app needs (listed in the setup guide below) and save

container_id.label: Container ID (Optional)
container_id.help: Leave empty to create a new container automatically. If you have multiple vehicles with the same Client ID, they will share the same container. Only provide an existing Container ID if you want to reuse one.

device_code.title: CarData Authentication
device_code.instructions: Follow these steps to authorize access to your car:
device_code.step1: 1. Click the button below to open your browser
device_code.step3: 3. Complete the authorization in your browser

error.auth_failed: Authorization failed. Please complete the authorization in your browser.

setup_error.title: Device Setup Failed
setup_error.hint: Sign-in succeeded, but setting up the car data container failed. Your sign-in is kept, so tapping Try Again will retry just the setup step without asking for a new authorization code.
